lines.text: A slinky. A strand of spaghetti. A jar of nuts. A coffee drop. A cup of water. And a raindrop. Six ordinary things. Each one hides a reason that is too quick, too small, or too hidden to see. So we'll slow each one down, until the physics shows.
lines.phonemes: ɐ slˈɪŋki. ɐ stɹˈænd ʌv spɐɡˈɛɾi. ɐ dʒˈɑːɹ ʌv nˈʌts. ɐ kˈɔfi dɹˈɑːp. ɐ kˈʌp ʌv wˈɔːɾɚ. ænd ɐ ɹˈeɪndɹɑːp. sˈɪks ˈɔːɹdɪnˌɛɹi θˈɪŋz. ˈiːtʃ wˈʌn hˈaɪdz ɐ ɹˈiːzən ðæt ɪz tˈuː kwˈɪk, tˈuː smˈɔːl, ɔːɹ tˈuː hˈɪdən tə sˈiː. sˌoʊ wiːl slˈoʊ ˈiːtʃ wˈʌn dˈaʊn, ʌntˈɪl ðə fˈɪzɪks ʃˈoʊz.

lines.text: The slinky's bottom waited, because the news of the drop had to travel down it, like a wave. A bending stick has the same problem. When it snaps, a wave from the break runs along it, and that wave can break it again.
lines.phonemes: ðə slˈɪŋkiz bˈɑːɾəm wˈeɪɾᵻd, bɪkˈʌz ðə nˈuːz ʌvðə dɹˈɑːp hædtə tɹˈævəl dˈaʊn ɪt, lˈaɪk ɐ wˈeɪv. ɐ bˈɛndɪŋ stˈɪk hɐz ðə sˈeɪm pɹˈɑːbləm. wˌɛn ɪt snˈæps, ɐ wˈeɪv fɹʌmðə bɹˈeɪk ɹˈʌnz ɐlˈɔŋ ɪt, ænd ðæt wˈeɪv kæn bɹˈeɪk ɪɾ ɐɡˈɛn.

lines.text: Spaghetti breaks into a few pieces. Now let's watch a whole jar of pieces at once. Shake it, and something strange happens to the biggest one.
lines.phonemes: spɐɡˈɛɾi bɹˈeɪks ˌɪntʊ ɐ fjˈuː pˈiːsᵻz. nˈaʊ lˈɛts wˈɑːtʃ ɐ hˈoʊl dʒˈɑːɹ ʌv pˈiːsᵻz ɐtwˈʌns. ʃˈeɪk ɪt, ænd sˈʌmθɪŋ stɹˈeɪndʒ hˈæpənz tə ðə bˈɪɡɪst wˌʌn.

lines.text: In the jar, the big nut rises because small grains slip into the gaps under it. Small things moving together can do surprising things. So can the tiny specks inside a drop of drying coffee.
lines.phonemes: ɪnðə dʒˈɑːɹ, ðə bˈɪɡ nˈʌt ɹˈaɪzᵻz bɪkˈʌz smˈɔːl ɡɹˈeɪnz slˈɪp ˌɪntʊ ðə ɡˈæps ˈʌndɚɹ ɪt. smˈɔːl θˈɪŋz mˈuːvɪŋ təɡˌɛðɚ kæn dˈuː sɚpɹˈaɪzɪŋ θˈɪŋz. sˌoʊ kæn ðə tˈaɪni spˈɛks ɪnsˈaɪd ɐ dɹˈɑːp ʌv dɹˈaɪɪŋ kˈɔfi.

lines.text: The coffee drop hid a flow that carries its specks to the edge. Now let's listen for a different hidden shape: the empty air inside a cup.
lines.phonemes: ðə kˈɔfi dɹˈɑːp hˈɪd ɐ flˈoʊ ðæt kˈæɹiz ɪts spˈɛks tə ðɪ ˈɛdʒ. nˈaʊ lˈɛts lˈɪsən fɚɹə dˈɪfɹənt hˈɪdən ʃˈeɪp: ðɪ ˈɛmpti ˈɛɹ ɪnsˈaɪd ɐ kˈʌp.

lines.text: A cup's note climbs as its empty space shrinks. For the last one, water is falling through the air instead, from a cloud.
lines.phonemes: ɐ kˈʌps nˈoʊt klˈaɪmz æz ɪts ˈɛmpti spˈeɪs ʃɹˈɪŋks. fɚðə lˈæst wˌʌn, wˈɔːɾɚɹ ɪz fˈɔːlɪŋ θɹuː ðɪ ˈɛɹ ɪnstˈɛd, fɹʌm ɐ klˈaʊd.

lines.text: A slinky that waits. A stick that breaks again. A nut that rises. A ring from a drop. A cup that sings. A raindrop with a speed limit. None of them needed new physics, only a slower look. And all of them were happening around you the whole time. Next time you see something ordinary, slow it down in your head.
lines.phonemes: ɐ slˈɪŋki ðæt wˈeɪts. ɐ stˈɪk ðæt bɹˈeɪks ɐɡˈɛn. ɐ nˈʌt ðæt ɹˈaɪzᵻz. ɐ ɹˈɪŋ fɹʌm ɐ dɹˈɑːp. ɐ kˈʌp ðæt sˈɪŋz. ɐ ɹˈeɪndɹɑːp wɪð ɐ spˈiːd lˈɪmɪt. nˈʌn ʌv ðˌɛm nˈiːdᵻd nˈuː fˈɪzɪks, ˈoʊnli ɐ slˈoʊɚ lˈʊk. ænd ˈɔːl ʌv ðˌɛm wɜː hˈæpənɪŋ ɚɹˈaʊnd juː ðə hˈoʊl tˈaɪm. nˈɛkst tˈaɪm juː sˈiː sˈʌmθɪŋ ˈɔːɹdɪnˌɛɹi, slˈoʊ ɪt dˌaʊn ɪn jʊɹ hˈɛd.
